notes.title: v0.1.4.5 Update – More Zombies, Deadly Traps, and Action at Its Peak!
notes.content:
[p]🧩 [b]1899: Secrets of the Maze – v0.1.4.5 Update is Live![/b][/p][p]🎯 [b]Highlights:[/b][/p][p]🧟‍♂️ [b]Zombie Count Increased[/b]
The maze is now far more dangerous! Expect higher zombie density — stay alert.[/p][p]🪓 [b]Melee Weapons Enhanced[/b]
– Axe and knife damage increased.
– The axe can now kill certain enemies with a single hit!
– Bonus: Axe, knife, and lighter now emit light in darkness![/p][p]🔫 [b]Pistol Updated with Auto-Reload Feature[/b]
Enjoy a smoother combat experience with automatic reloading.[/p][p]🔴 [b]Laser Traps Introduced[/b]
Sudden laser beams now test your reflexes. Watch your step at all times![/p][p]🎵 [b]Music Control Added[/b]
You can now completely mute background music via the [i]Music Volume[/i] setting.[/p][p]🔥 [b]Action System Finalized[/b]
Melee combat, gunfights, traps, and survival in darkness are now fully implemented.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🛠️ [b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/p][p]🔫 [b]Weapon Damage Boosted[/b]
Defeat enemies much more efficiently![/p][p]🕯️ [b]Explore with the Lantern[/b]
Illuminate your path and uncover the maze’s secrets using the lantern item.[/p][p]🎒 [b]Inventory System Rebalanced[/b]
– Pistol Ammo: 3 boxes (33 bullets each)
– Flashlight Battery: Max 6 units
– Lantern Ammo: Max 3 units
– Medical Kit: 1 unit
– Healing Elixir: Max 33 units[/p][p]💾 [b]Autosave System Implemented[/b]
The game now auto-saves when reaching specific coordinates. Your progress is protected from sudden deaths.[/p][p]🌐 [b]Asian Font Fixes[/b]
Font issues resolved for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
Note: Minor font glitches may still appear in some UI elements (like Q/Inspect and E/Use keys), but all story notes display perfectly across languages. Tested in both Editor and Steam builds.[/p][p]🛠️ [b]Steam DRM Launch Issue Resolved[/b]
Startup problems caused by Steam DRM have been fixed. The game should now launch reliably.[/p][p]🚪 [b]Quit Button Issue Fixed[/b]
A bug that prevented proper exiting via the Quit button has been addressed. Exits now work as expected.[/p][hr][/hr]

notes.title: v0.1.4.4
notes.content:
🧩 1899: Secrets of the Maze v0.1.4.4 Update is Live!

🎯 Highlights:

🪓 Melee Weapons Enhanced
– The damage dealt by the axe and knife has been increased.
– The axe, knife, and lighter now have the ability to illuminate darkness!

🔫 Pistol Improvements
– A new auto-reload feature has been added for smoother combat experience.

🎒 Inventory System Adjusted
– Pistol Ammo: Limited to 3 boxes of 33 rounds each.
– Flashlight Batteries: Limited to a maximum of 6.
– Lantern Ammo: Limited to a maximum of 3.
– Medical Kit: Limited to 1 per player.
– Healing Elixir: Limited to a maximum of 33 units.
🔄 Work Has Begun on the v0.1.4.5 Update!

🛠️ The next update will focus on balance adjustments and new challenge mechanics.

📌 Planned Changes:

🔥 Lighter Mechanics Being Re-Evaluated
– The lighter currently provides too much light, and this may be balanced in v0.1.4.5.

🧍‍♂️ Increased NPC and Zombie Density
– More enemies may be added in certain areas, especially where action is currently lacking.

⚖️ Difficulty Balancing in Progress
– Some players find the game too easy, while others find it too difficult.
A new system is being tested to achieve a better difficulty balance.

💡 Laser Trap Mechanic Under Testing
– Sudden laser traps may appear when stepping forward.
Players may need to jump or crouch to avoid them.
– This feature is still in the testing phase and may or may not be included, depending on the final decision regarding the lighter adjustments.

notes.title: v0.1.4.3
notes.content:
🧩 1899: Secrets of the Maze v0.1.4.3 Update is Live!

🎯 Highlights:

🌐 Font Fixes for Asian Languages
Font issues in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean have been fixed.
However, some UI elements — especially those showing Q (Examine) and E (Use) prompts — may still display incorrectly.
No font problems were found in story-related notes. All tested both in the editor and on Steam builds.

💾 Autosave System Added
The game now features an autosave system. Reaching certain coordinates will trigger automatic saving, helping players avoid major progress loss after unexpected deaths.

🛠️ Steam DRM Issue Resolved
An issue caused by Steam DRM that prevented the game from launching correctly for some users has been fixed.

🚪 Quit Button Exit Bug Fixed
An issue that caused problems when exiting the game via the Quit button has been resolved. The game now exits cleanly.

🔮 Coming Soon in v0.1.4.4:

🧧 Story-Linked Items Will Gain Unique Abilities
Certain key items tied to the story will receive special functions — similar to the lantern mechanic.
These items include:

    🪓 Axe

    🔪 Knife

    🔥 Lighter

🎒 Inventory Balance & Lantern Limitation

    The number of excessive inventory items will be reduced.

    Lantern fuel will now be limited to a maximum of 3.
    This change is being made because the lantern currently acts as an extremely powerful defensive tool.
    With it, you can survive even if 40 zombies attack you at once — and this will now be rebalanced.

🧟‍♂️ Increased Zombie Density

    The number of zombies will be increased between coordinates A1 and A9-9, making those areas more challenging and intense.

🧍‍♂️ NPC Count & Placement Adjustments

    NPC count will be increased between coordinates E9-9 and E1.

    Their positions will be strategically reorganized.

    Some NPCs will become immune to bullets, encouraging players to explore alternative strategies.

🪓 New Special Function for the Axe
To deal with bullet-immune NPCs, the axe will gain a unique effect or interaction mechanic.
This will give players new tactical options during encounters.

notes.title: "1899: Secrets of the Maze" Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I'm excited to share that "1899: Secrets of the Maze" is almost finished and will be released very soon!

At launch, the game will officially support English, but I’ve also added beta-level translations for 34 other languages. These translations are not fully polished yet, but they’ll allow players to experience the story in their own language.

🗣️ Available languages (beta quality):
Turkish, English, German, Swedish, French, Italian, Castilian Spanish, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese, Bulgarian, Danish, Indonesian, Dutch, Finnish, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Latin American Spanish, Polish, Hungarian, Norwegian, Portuguese (Portugal), Romanian, Russian, Thai, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Greek, Czech, Croatian, Slovak, Serbian, Hebrew, Icelandic.

I’ll continue improving all translations and font compatibility after release.
Thank you for your support — I’ve been working on this project solo, and your encouragement means a lot.

Get ready… the maze is waiting.

notes.title: 1899: Secrets of the Maze is Now More Accessible and Thrilling!
notes.content:
Get ready to dive into the heart of a mysterious story as a detective! 1899: Secrets of the Maze takes you on a unique adventure into a maze filled with secrets, where you'll cross into another realm. The game narrates its story through notes, unraveling new mysteries with every step.

The game features a coordinate system (A1, A2, L1, L2, T1, T2, etc.) designed to make navigation easier, ensuring an enjoyable experience for players. With ample ammunition provided, you won’t face shortages, making it perfect for both seasoned and new players. The game is crafted to be accessible to everyone, with simple mechanics to help you find your way.

This exceptional adventure is available for just $2-5. Are you ready to explore this world filled with mystery and fear? Join now and uncover the secrets!
